meta.name: digitalai-migration-skill
meta.description: Migrate test automation from Digital.ai Continuous Testing (Experitest / SeeTest) to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers cloud.seetest.io and company.experitest.com grids, accessKey auth, digitalai:options, deviceQuery selectors, cloud: app references, seetest:client.* commands, Cloud Agent. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from Digital.ai Continuous Testing to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from Digital.ai Continuous Testing, mentions seetest, experitest, digitalai:options, deviceQuery, SEETEST_IO_ACCESS_KEY, cloud: app values, seetest:client, reportUrl, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on Digital.ai Continuous Testing, even without the word migrate.
